main_measure.name: mean excess next-day return on long bars (minus coin's all-window mean daily return)

statistic.name: t of the mean over day sums

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and upper-minus-lower > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-half minus lower-half mean excess return at the median forecast (Welch t n/a)

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 (or its sign disagrees with the mean), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are bars with postRebalance_current_allocation > 0 and a next close in the same window; the mean is over cases and the t over day sums of the excess; the median split puts forecasts above the median in the upper half and the rest in the lower; the profile is read from `regime` since its 365-bar inputs are not in the record, the low close and width are recomputed from prices.
